spirit:busDefinition.spirit:name: szg_adc_ltc226x
spirit:busDefinition.spirit:description: SZG-ADC-LTC226X SYZYGY peripheral full pinout: LVDS data (OUT1A/B, OUT2A/B as 2-bit channel buses), frame (FR), data clock (DCO), encode clock (ENC), and 4-wire SPI control (SCLK, SDI, SDO, CS_B). Manager = FPGA side.
